d: From a former Scientology lab and an abandoned desert complex to a historic prison and a ship with a haunting past, the Ghost Adventures crew takes its investigations into places filled with unexplained stories. Armed with night-vision cameras, thermal imaging equipment and paranormal investigation tools, Zak Bagans and his team search for evidence that the naked eye might miss. Strange recordings, unusual readings and unexplained activity keep raising questions about what could be lurking beyond the reach of ordinary cameras. But what will the crew capture when the lights go out?
